en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.trend.micr: Trend Micro Vision One is a leading endpoint security solution that combines advanced threat detection, prevention, and response capabilities. The platform leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning to protect organizations against sophisticated cyber threats including malware, ransomware, and zero-day attacks.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.with.cloud: With cloud-native architecture and comprehensive threat intelligence, Trend Micro Vision One provides enterprise-grade security that scales from small businesses to global organizations. The solution integrates seamlessly with existing security infrastructure while offering centralized management and visibility across all endpoints.
Built for the modern threat landscape, Trend Micro Vision One delivers proactive protection through behavioral analysis, sandboxing, and automated response—stopping threats before they can cause damage.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.machine.le: Machine learning-powered threat detection that identifies known and unknown malware.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.continuous: Continuous monitoring and prevention of threats across all endpoints.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.extended.d: Extended detection and response capabilities for comprehensive threat visibility.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.centralize: Centralized cloud console for managing security across distributed environments.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.specialize: Specialized defense against ransomware with rollback and recovery capabilities.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.global.int: Global intelligence network providing real-time threat data and insights.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.trend.micr: Trend Micro certifications validate expertise in XDR (Extended Detection and Response), threat intelligence, and multi-layered security. These credentials demonstrate proficiency with Vision One unified security platform.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.deploy.and: Deploy and manage Trend Micro security solutions including Vision One XDR, endpoint security, and email protection.
en.review.trend-micro-vision-one.advanced.x: Advanced XDR threat hunting, custom detection rules, API integration, and enterprise architecture design.

pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.trend.micr: Trend Micro Vision One é uma solução líder de segurança de endpoints que combina detecção avançada de ameaças, prevenção e recursos de resposta. A plataforma aproveita inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina para proteger organizações contra sofisticadas ameaças cibernéticas, incluindo malware, ransomware e ataques zero-day.
pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.with.cloud: Com arquitetura nativa da nuvem e inteligência de ameaças abrangente, Trend Micro Vision One fornece segurança em nível empresarial que escala de pequenas empresas para organizações globais. A solução se integra perfeitamente com a infraestrutura de segurança existente, oferecendo gerenciamento centralizado e visibilidade em todos os endpoints.
Construído para o cenário moderno de ameaças, Trend Micro Vision One oferece proteção proativa por meio de análise comportamental, isolamento e resposta automatizada, interrompendo ameaças antes que possam causar danos.
pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.machine.le: Detecção de ameaças impulsionada por aprendizado de máquina que identifica malware conhecido e desconhecido.
pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.continuous: Monitoramento contínuo e prevenção de ameaças em todos os endpoints.

pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.centralize: Console de nuvem centralizado para gerenciar segurança em ambientes distribuídos.
pt.review.trend-micro-vision-one.specialize: Defesa especializada contra ransomware com recursos de reversão e recuperação.

zh.review.trend-micro-vision-one.trend.micr: Trend Micro Vision One 是一款领先的端点安全解决方案,结合了高级威胁检测、防御和响应功能。该平台利用人工智能和机器学习来保护组织免受复杂的网络威胁,包括恶意软件、勒索软件和零日攻击。
zh.review.trend-micro-vision-one.with.cloud: 凭借云原生架构和全面的威胁情报,Trend Micro Vision One 提供可扩展的企业级安全,从小型企业到全球组织都能适用。该解决方案与现有安全基础设施无缝集成,同时提供集中管理和跨所有端点的可见性。
为现代威胁环境而构建,Trend Micro Vision One 通过行为分析、沙盒技术和自动响应提供主动保护,在威胁造成损害之前将其阻止。

ja.review.trend-micro-vision-one.trend.micr: Trend Micro Vision One は、高度な脅威検出、防止、および対応機能を組み合わせた最先端のエンドポイントセキュリティソリューションです。このプラットフォームは、人工知能と機械学習を活用して、マルウェア、ランサムウェア、ゼロデイ攻撃を含む高度なサイバー脅威から組織を保護します。
ja.review.trend-micro-vision-one.with.cloud: クラウドネイティブアーキテクチャと包括的な脅威インテリジェンスにより、Trend Micro Vision One は小規模企業から世界規模の組織まで対応できるエンタープライズグレードのセキュリティを提供します。このソリューションは既存のセキュリティインフラストラクチャとシームレスに統合され、すべてのエンドポイント全体での一元管理と可視性を提供します。
最新の脅威環境向けに構築された Trend Micro Vision One は、動作分析、サンドボックス、自動対応を通じて積極的な保護を提供し、脅威が被害を与える前にそれらを阻止します。

ja.review.trend-micro-vision-one.continuous: すべてのエンドポイント全体での脅威の継続的な監視と防止。
ja.review.trend-micro-vision-one.extended.d: 包括的な脅威の可視性のための拡張検出および対応機能。
